checks: Server-side required, length, type and URL validation
Fixed sender/recipient, visitor Reply-To, escaped HTML and text email
Provider acceptance is separate from delivery
Stable retry key; changed payload gets a different key
Missing key, provider failure, malformed response and simulated timeout
No-JavaScript failure keeps editable answers; success receipt
No secret or provider error in public response
limitations: Resend account/domain, receiving mailbox, production function and actual delivery are unverified.
